# Support

Use [Discussions](https://github.com/seanlimailbox-coder/Seenla-Audio/discussions) for installation questions, plugin usage, workflow ideas, and general feedback.

Use [Issues](https://github.com/seanlimailbox-coder/Seenla-Audio/issues) for reproducible bugs or specific feature requests. Search existing reports first, then choose the matching template.

## Information to include

- Plugin name and exact version.
- Package filename or GitHub release link.
- macOS version, Mac processor, DAW name and version, and whether the DAW runs natively or under Rosetta.
- Plugin format: VST3 or AU.
- Sample rate and buffer size for audio, latency, or performance problems.
- What you expected, what happened, and the shortest steps that reproduce it.

For a crash or failed scan, include the relevant error text or crash report. For an audio problem, list the settings and say whether it also happens in a fresh session with one plugin instance. Screenshots or short recordings can help explain a UI issue.

Reports and attachments are public. Use a minimal example you are comfortable sharing.

See [installation and compatibility](../docs/installation.md) for package selection, installation folders, updates, and rescanning.
